question: Who among the following won a silver medal in the women's 57 kg category at the Individual Wrestling World Cup held in Serbia in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anshu Malik.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anshu Malik**__

 __
 
• Anshu Malik is an **Indian freestyle wrestler.**
 
• She won the silver medal in the women's 57 kg event at the **2021 World Wrestling Championship **held in Oslo, Norway.
 
• She is the first Indian wrestler to win a silver medal at the World Championships.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aisuluu Tynybekova**__

 __
 
• She is a **Kyrgyzstani freestyle wrestler.**
 
• She won the **silver medal in the women's 62 kg** event at the **2020 Summer Olympics held in Tokyo, Japan.**
 
• She also competed in the women's 63kg event at the 2012 Summer Olympics, the first woman to wrestle for Kyrgyzstan in the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Veronika Chumikova**__
 
 
• She is a** Russian freestyle wrestler** of Chuvash heritage.
 
• She is a** silver medalist** at the European Wrestling Championships.
 
• She also won a** medal at the Golden Grand Prix Ivan Yarygin held in Krasnoyarsk.**
